task.title: Remove Narrative Craft and replace it with bounded Roleplay prose guidance
task.source: Direct user request after live Narrative Craft regressions and a fixed-model prompt experiment.
task.classification: prompt assembly, legacy configuration compatibility, agent removal, and Roleplay behavior

coreClaim: Narrative Craft no longer plans, analyzes, repairs, stores, or controls generated scenes, while Roleplay receives one bounded prose-shape guide that cannot choose plot beats and does not affect Conversation or Game.
rootCause: Narrative Craft combined hidden beat planning, background analysis, deterministic rewriting, memory, and UI state. Its high-priority private guidance could contradict the user's requested scene direction, and its broader intervention made prose feel more automated rather than less.

inScope: Narrative Craft and Conversation Craft runtime removal
Built-in and legacy craft-agent contract cleanup
Roleplay-only contrastive prose guidance at the writer prompt boundary
Obsolete evaluation tooling and documentation removal
outOfScope: Changing the writer model or provider
Adding another agent, critic, detector, planner, or rewrite pass
Changing Conversation or Game prose behavior
Deleting existing user chat messages or agent-run history

claimBoundary.coreClaim: All Roleplay writer entrypoints receive exactly one bounded prose-shape guide immediately before the final user instruction; retired craft behavior cannot re-enter through saved agent IDs, replay caches, retries, or UI controls.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt assembly and legacy configuration compatibility
entrypoints: Agent catalog and Roleplay settings UI
currentPathsOrFormats: Roleplay prompts assembled from engine messages and generation guides
Structured context injections with agentType and text
legacyPathsOrFormats: Saved narrative-craft, prose-guardian, director, and secret-plot-driver IDs
outOfScopeClaims: The guide eliminates every possible AI-shaped phrase
The guide improves every model or every writing style
Post-merge Pi runtime behavior before exact images are deployed

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Hidden craft machinery could override explicit Roleplay steering and mutate output after the writer response.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine Roleplay prompt assembly and generation orchestration
contractLaneGate.consumer: Writer-model requests across normal, direct, preview, and dry-run paths
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: User scene direction owns what happens; internal prose guidance may shape phrasing but may not choose beats or rewrite completed output.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: A pure Roleplay-only helper inserts one static style block before the final user message, while all craft planner, analysis, repair, memory, retry, and UI paths are removed or retired.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Engine generation owns prompt semantics and mode-specific writer guidance.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not recreate prose correction in React, Rust, provider transport, or a post-generation agent.
regressionProof: withRoleplayProseShapeGuidance inserts one system message immediately before the final Roleplay user message
Conversation and Game negative controls receive no prose-shape guide
A dry-run model request proves the guide reaches the real writer boundary

positiveRows.claim: The bounded guide reaches the real Roleplay model request at the intended priority.
positiveRows.evidence: Focused generation-guide and dry-run tests passed; the dry-run request contains one Roleplay Prose Guidance system message immediately before the final user message.

positiveRows.claim: The replacement improves the evaluated prose direction without changing models.
positiveRows.evidence: A private fixed-model A/B/C harness produced 120 non-empty held-out outputs after invalid empty streams were rejected and rerun; the contrastive condition reduced heuristic shape flags versus baseline, and the user selected contrastive 5/5 in blinded comparisons.

positiveRows.claim: The complete removal and replacement satisfy repository contracts.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm check passed, including frontend types, Rust workspace, architecture, security, storage contracts, docs, discovery, workflow guards, and warning-only unused reporting.

contradictionRows.claim: The guide must not leak into Conversation or Game.
contradictionRows.evidence: Pure helper negative controls return the original prompt unchanged for both modes.

contradictionRows.claim: The guide must not suppress intentionally lyrical prose.
contradictionRows.evidence: The instruction explicitly exempts requested voice/scene shapes; the user preferred the contrastive output for the lyrical three-part-list control.

contradictionRows.claim: Retired injection formats must not restore hidden craft authority.
contradictionRows.evidence: Replay and runtime normalization discard legacy string injections and structured injections from retired craft agent types.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing chats with retired craft IDs remain usable without reactivating those agents.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Legacy built-in IDs remain recognized for catalog filtering while runtime overrides, retries, replay injections, defaults, and controls no longer execute them.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: New chats no longer opt into background craft agents.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Chat schema tests prove Roleplay, Conversation, and Game creation adds no background-agent metadata by default.

untestedRows: Live Pi behavior remains pending until the exact merge SHA's server and web images are published and deployed.

ownedFacts.description: The fixed experiment used one writer model, one connection, and one parameter hash across all 120 held-out runs.
ownedFacts.evidence: Private matrix invariant validation reported 120 unique non-empty runs, 40 per condition, one model, and one parameter hash.

ownedFacts.description: The final treatment contains only prose-shape instruction and contrastive examples, with no beat or plot directive.
ownedFacts.evidence: The checked-in constant and focused assertion reject plot, beat-plan, and what-happens-next language.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Bunny checked for non-Roleplay leakage, placement after explicit user steering, and reintroduction of hidden plot authority.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: No corrective change required; mode isolation, prompt order, and guidance content are directly covered by focused tests.

verification.baselineCommand: pnpm check; focused generation-guide and start-generation tests; pnpm typecheck; pnpm check:architecture; git diff --check
verification.baselineEvidence: 28 focused tests and the full repository gate passed on the final local product commit.
negativeRowsTested: Legacy string and structured craft injections
Existing chats with retired craft IDs

notes: No private chat text, private experiment corpus, provider secrets, or API keys are included.
Bunny reviewed the complete product diff before the PR and found no blocking issue.
